description: The file contains server-side logic for the StartExam page of an online examination system. It manages session validation, populates course selections based on user semester, and handles starting exams of different types (Theory or MCQ). It also manages navigation and checks if a student has already taken a particular exam.

classes.name: StartExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the StartExam ASP.NET page, managing exam start procedures, user session validation, course selection, and exam initiation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event, validates user session, and populates course dropdown based on the user's semester.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Redirects the user to the dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Redirects the user to the user profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Redirects the user to the leaderboard page.

methods.name: startB_Click
methods.description: Initiates the process to start an exam based on selected exam type and course, checking availability and setting session variables.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to the login page.

methods.name: GridView1_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection of a theory exam, checks if already taken, and prepares for exam start.

methods.name: GridView2_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection of an MCQ exam, checks if already taken, and prepares for exam start.
